lastResponse.text: You’re making sense, and this is urgent. Chest tightness plus no sleep and hearing things can be a medical emergency. Please call 9 1 1 now, especially if you feel unsafe or the chest pressure gets worse. If you want, stay with me and I can connect you to a live 2 1 1 specialist right now for same-day care support without sharing your address first.
